newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia stocks computer system back up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia stocks computer system back up.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange said on Friday morning that its Stock Exchange Automatic Trading System (SEATS) computer trading system was back on line after it stopped operating at about 11.00 a.m. (0000 GMT).
The exchange said the market would go into pre-open trade at 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT) and re-open at 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT).
